enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket up. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Sleeps. Turns to right side. Kicks off blanket. Pulls blanket back. Sleeps. Shifts arm. Moves leg. Turns head. Sleeps.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, brushing teeth, and morning wash
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Scrubs body. Rinses body. Turns off water. Steps out. Dries with towel. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in work scrubs and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out scrubs. Puts on scrubs. Takes out socks from drawer. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Opens work bag. Places stethoscope, badge, wallet, and phone in bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a quick breakfast of toast and tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread, butter, and milk. Closes refrigerator. Places bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever. Takes out mug and tea bag. Places tea bag in mug. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Pours water into mug. Adds milk. Stirs tea. Takes toast out of toaster. Spreads butter on toast. Eats toast. Drinks tea. Rinses mug. Places mug in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the morning shift
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up work bag. Walks out of house. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Swipes transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Takes out phone. Checks messages. Puts phone away. Looks out window. Gets off bus. Walks to hospital entrance. Enters hospital. Walks to locker room. Changes into work shoes. Stores bag in locker. Walks to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the hospital: ward handover, patient assessments, and medication administration
enriched_activities.desc: Attends handover meeting. Listens to report. Takes notes. Reviews patient charts. Walks to patient room. Greets patient. Checks vital signs. Measures blood pressure. Measures temperature. Checks pulse. Administers medication. Documents in chart. Walks to next patient. Repeats assessments. Coordinates with care team. Discusses patient status. Updates care plan. Assists with patient mobility. Changes wound dressing. Monitors IV drip.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break in the hospital staff room
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to staff room. Opens refrigerator. Takes out lunch bag. Sits at table. Opens lunch bag. Takes out sandwich. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Wipes mouth. Throws away trash. Checks phone. Replies to messages. Closes lunch bag. Stands up. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the hospital: continued patient care, clinical documentation, and coordinating with the care team
enriched_activities.desc: Checks patient list. Walks to patient room. Assists patient with mobility. Changes wound dressing. Monitors IV drip. Adjusts flow rate. Documents care. Calls doctor. Discusses medication change. Updates family. Coordinates with care team. Attends team meeting. Reviews care plans. Administers medication. Checks vital signs. Documents in chart. Walks to next patient. Repeats tasks.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Swipes transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Takes out phone. Checks emails. Puts phone away. Looks out window. Gets off bus. Walks home. Enters home. Removes shoes. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Scrubs body. Rinses body. Turns off water. Steps out. Dries with towel. Walks to bedroom. Changes into casual clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading work uniforms into the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up work uniforms. Walks to bathroom. Opens washing machine door. Places uniforms inside. Adds detergent. Closes door. Turns on washing machine. Selects cycle. Presses start. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and chicken. Closes refrigerator. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds chicken. Stirs. Adds vegetables. Adds spices. Stirs. Covers pan. Waits. Turns off stove. Serves onto plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table. Picks up fork. Picks up knife. Cuts food. Eats food. Drinks water. Wipes mouth with napkin. Continues eating. Finishes meal. Stands up. Picks up plate. Places plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing dinner dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up plates. Scrapes food into trash. Rinses plates. Opens dishwasher. Places plates in dishwasher. Places utensils in basket. Closes dishwasher. Wipes counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Moving laundry from the washing machine to the dryer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Opens washing machine. Takes out wet clothes. Opens dryer. Places clothes in dryer. Closes dryer door. Turns on dryer. Selects cycle. Presses start. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Browses channels. Selects show. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Changes channel. Watches more. Picks up phone. Checks social media. Puts phone down. Watches TV. Stands up. Gets water. Sits back down.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for personal admin and checking emails
enriched_activities.desc: Opens laptop. Turns on computer. Enters password. Opens email client. Checks emails. Replies to email. Types message. Sends email. Opens browser. Checks bank account. Pays bill. Closes browser. Opens document. Edits document. Saves document. Closes computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene routine and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Applies moisturizer. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Unwinding with TV and light reading
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Selects show. Watches TV. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads pages. Turns page. Puts book down. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts phone down. Turns off TV. Stands up. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns off light. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Sleeps. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Sleeps. Shifts arm. Moves leg. Turns head. Sleeps. Breathes deeply. Sleeps.
